verdict_reason: The rename from commodity to commodityCode is correct, but the comment above it describes another page and gives rationale, and its name clashes with a different-rule identifierColumns in animal-identification.

todos.issue: The comment at lines 12-15 describes another page ('the order the identification page asked for them') and gives rationale ('this is a read-back of what was entered, not a list of what was asked for'). House rules: a comment describes only the lines below it, never other modules or the UI, and rationale goes in docs/ or the behaviour spec.
todos.fix: Must: no comment above identifierColumns; the name and body say what columns it returns. One way: delete the comment and, if the read-back rule is not already in the openspec check-answers spec, add it there.

todos.issue: identifierColumns(units, commodityCode) here returns only the identifiers some unit has filled in, plus permanent address when a unit carries one. A function with the same name, identifierColumns(commodityCode, species) in commodities/animal-identification/identifier/table.js:17, returns every identifier the commodity declares, plus permanent address when the species requires it. One name, two different rules, and this PR changed the signature of both.
todos.fix: Must: each function's name says which columns it returns, so a reader cannot mistake the filled-in read-back for the declared set. One way: rename this one filledIdentifierColumns (or similar) and update identifier-table.js.
